scope: Metadata-only source discovery during live training; not a development reservation, no model/audio download or candidate inference.

findings.jenny_dioco: Card explicitly says finetuned from hifi_tts_92, the Cori Samuel base already used in training. Distinct target corpus does not imply independent pretraining. Dataset license requires primary-source review; no reservation.
findings.hfc_female: Card explicitly says finetuned from the same hifi_tts_92/Cori base. Dataset Hi-Fi Captain; card lists CC BY-NC-SA4.0. Not certified pretraining-independent; no reservation.
findings.kristin: Card says trained from scratch on ~11.5h LibriVox recordings. Physical speaker overlap with existing LibriTTS/LibriSpeech-derived sources unresolved; not certified independent, no reservation.

decision: Do not treat any as proven independent source. Preserve evidence; future reservation requires explicit overlap/lineage limits and protocol before scoring. No transfer to training, no consumption of three existing final sets.
